user.title: Add a PC
user.description: How can Home Assistant reach the PC?

menu_options.manual: Home Assistant connects to the PC (it is on the home network)
menu_options.reverse: The PC connects to Home Assistant (a laptop that roams)

manual.title: Connect to a PC
manual.description: Enter the address of the PC that runs the QoffeeAutomat agent.

data_description.host: Host name or IP address of the PC.
data_description.port: The QoffeeLink port of the agent (default 8481).

reverse.title: Let the PC connect to Home Assistant
reverse.description: Enter the address under which the PC can reach Home Assistant from wherever it is. It must use https, because the PC proves who it is with a secret token.

data_description.fingerprint: SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate, only for a self-signed certificate or a private certificate authority. Leave it empty for a normal certificate.

reverse_rotate.title: Create a new token
reverse_rotate.description: The PC connects to Home Assistant with a secret token. A new token replaces the old one, and the PC has to be enrolled again with it.

data_description.fingerprint: SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate, only for a self-signed certificate or a private certificate authority. Leave it empty for a normal certificate.

reverse_show.title: Enroll the PC
reverse_show.description:
Give this enrollment string to the agent on the PC (join the reverse link in the agent). It contains a secret: it is shown only now, and treat it like a password.

`{enrollment}`

Select Submit when the agent has it. The old token stops working then, and a PC that still uses it is rejected until it is enrolled with the new string.

confirm.title: Confirm the agent
confirm.description:
Found {name} at {host}:{port}.

Certificate fingerprint (SHA-256):
`{fingerprint}`

Compare it with the fingerprint in the agent's pairing dialog before you continue.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description: Open the pairing dialog in the agent's web interface and enter the six-digit code. The code is valid for five minutes.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair with {name} again
reauth_confirm.description:
The agent at {host}:{port} no longer accepts the saved access. Start pairing in the agent's web interface and enter the new six-digit code.

Certificate fingerprint (SHA-256):
`{fingerprint}`

reconfigure.title: Change the address
reconfigure.description: Enter the new address of the PC. It must be the same agent.

data_description.host: Host name or IP address of the PC.
data_description.port: The QoffeeLink port of the agent (default 8481).

progress.waiting_for_agent:
Give this enrollment string to the agent on the PC (join the reverse link in the agent). It contains a secret, so treat it like a password. The PC will dial {url}.

`{enrollment}`

This page continues by itself as soon as the PC connects.

error.invalid_reverse_url: Enter an https:// address of Home Assistant. A plain http:// address would send the token unencrypted.
error.invalid_fingerprint: A SHA-256 fingerprint has 64 hexadecimal digits.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the agent. Check the address, that the agent is running and that the certificate has not changed.
error.code_expired: The pairing code has expired or was blocked after too many attempts. Start pairing again in the agent.
error.unsupported_protocol: The agent and this integration do not share a QoffeeLink protocol version. Update the agent or the integration.
error.invalid_auth: The agent rejected the saved access. Re-authenticate the integration.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. See the log for details.

abort.already_in_progress: Setting up this agent is already in progress.
abort.invalid_discovery: The discovery announcement of the agent is incomplete.
abort.unsupported_protocol: The agent and this integration do not share a QoffeeLink protocol version. Update the agent or the integration.
abort.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. See the log for details.
abort.wrong_agent: The address belongs to a different agent.
abort.reverse_no_http: Home Assistant has no web server that the PC could connect to.
abort.reverse_timeout: No PC used the enrollment string in time. Start again when the agent is ready.

init.title: Wake-on-LAN
init.description: The Wake-on-LAN button sends magic packets for the network adapters of the PC to this address. The PC must be set up for waking, see the documentation.

data_description.broadcast: IPv4 broadcast address of the network of the PC, for example 192.168.1.255. The default 255.255.255.255 reaches the local network of Home Assistant only.

error.invalid_broadcast: Enter an IPv4 address, for example 192.168.1.255.

confirm.title: {name} speaks an incompatible protocol version
confirm.description:
The QoffeeAutomat agent {name} supports the QoffeeLink protocol versions {agent_protocol}, this integration supports {integration_protocol}. There is no common version.

Update the agent on the PC or update this integration, then select Submit to reload it.

run_command.name: Run command
run_command.description: Runs a command of the agent on the PC and optionally returns its output.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The PC on which the command should run.

command.name: Command
command.description: Id of the command, as shown in the agent's web interface.

variables.name: Variables
variables.description: Values for the variables of the command, by variable name. The values can come from templates.

wait.name: Wait for the result
wait.description: Wait until the command has finished and return its exit code and output.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: How long to wait for the result, in seconds.

wake.name: Wake the PC
wake.description: Send Wake-on-LAN magic packets first if the PC is not connected. Use it together with Wait until, otherwise the command runs before the PC is up.

wait_for.name: Wait until
wait_for.description: Wait before the command runs: until the PC is connected, or until it is connected and a user session is ready for desktop commands.

ready_timeout.name: Waiting time
ready_timeout.description: How long to wait for the PC, in seconds. If it is not ready in time, the action fails and the command does not run.

send_notification.name: Send notification
send_notification.description: Shows a notification on the desktop of the PC, with an optional picture and up to three buttons. A press of a button is reported as the event notification_action.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The PC that shows the notification.

image_url.name: Picture address
image_url.description: An http or https address of a picture (PNG, JPEG, GIF or BMP, up to 1 MiB). The agent on the PC fetches it; if it cannot, the notification appears without the picture.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: A name that comes back with every button press, so an automation can tell notifications apart. A new notification with the same tag replaces the old one.

actions.name: Buttons
actions.description: Up to three buttons, each with an action (the id that comes back in the event) and a title (the text on the button).

agent_offline.message: The agent is not connected, so the command {command} cannot run.

command_timeout.message: The agent did not answer in time while running the command {command}.

device_not_found.message: The device {device_id} is not a QoffeeAutomat device.

cannot_connect.message: Cannot connect to the agent at {host}:{port}.

invalid_auth.message: The agent rejected the saved access.

unsupported_protocol.message: The agent and this integration do not share a QoffeeLink protocol version.

manifest_unavailable.message: The agent did not deliver its manifest.

wol_no_mac.message: No MAC address of the PC is known, so it cannot be woken.

wol_failed.message: The magic packet could not be sent: {error}

ready_timeout_connected.message: The PC {name} did not connect within {timeout} seconds, so the command {command} was not run.

ready_timeout_session_ready.message: The PC {name} connected, but its session was not ready (the metric session.ready was not on) within {timeout} seconds, so the command {command} was not run.

ready_timeout_queued.message: The command {command} was still waiting for an earlier call for the PC {name} to start when {timeout} seconds were over, so it was not run.

session_ready_unsupported.message: The agent of {name} does not report the metric session.ready, so it is not possible to wait until the session is ready.

reverse_entry_invalid.message: This entry of a PC that connects to Home Assistant has no token. Remove it and add the PC again.

reverse_no_http.message: The web server of Home Assistant is not ready, so the PC cannot connect yet.

notify_unsupported.message: The agent does not offer notifications, so no notification can be shown.

notification_failed.message: The PC could not show the notification: {message}

invalid_notification_id.message: The {what} "{value}" is not valid. Use 1 to 64 letters, digits and the characters _ . : -.

too_many_notification_actions.message: A notification can have at most {max} buttons.

update_refused.message: The agent did not install the update: {message}

duplicate_notification_action.message: The button id {action} is used twice; every button needs its own id.
